good_thing: (Shenandoah Valley, Virginia): Retired neighbors John Rice and John Sessler are managing their farms across property lines to reconnect wildlife habitat. Rice’s outreach has helped protect nearly 2,500 acres of private land over 25 years, while the Sesslers have planted native seed mixes for birds, pollinators, and other wildlife. Smithsonian-supported surveys are finding native understory species that suggest the approach is working.
current_or_history: Mary Shelley was born in London on August 30, 1797. At 18, while storm-bound near Geneva with fellow writers in the summer of 1816, she joined a ghost-story challenge and developed the idea that became Frankenstein.
tiny_fact: Butterflies taste with their feet. Female butterflies have extra foot-based taste receptors that help them identify suitable host plants for laying eggs.
thought: A small bit of tending can make more room for life than we expect.
